start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:lock-in for 90 minutes on finishing the pricing page for my bakery site, and shut everything else out until I am done." It picks the block, sets up the room, silences your computer for 90 minutes, then asks what got done and books the next session.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Connect your computer to Trillion if you want it quieted (the during step says so and carries on when none is connected).
2. Say "Run workflow:lock-in" with minutes (5 to 720; left out it is 120, or the free time before your next calendar event) and what, when you already know what the session is for.

3. Answer the one question in step before if it asks what must be ready before you sit down to work; it is saved, and anything not ready is set up in step surroundings or put on your Waiting on you list.

4. Work. At the end say you are done; step after releases your computer, asks what got done against the result it named, runs your due practice questions and books the next session at the next free block.
